name: Thunder Orb
notes:
Numbers: the orb travels at about 60 px/s (2.0 px a tick since 2026-10-25; 1.6, about 48 px/s, before: +25% as the user asked) and zaps enemies within 70. Its collision body is a 3 px circle (6 before) so corners of the geometry snag it less; the look is bigger: the vanilla lightning ball at radius 5 (was 3) under the mod's orb sprite at 1.5x (torrent.unit, effects/orb.effect).

In game (hwp_wiz_tempest_torrent, tested): a slow orb along the aim that passes through enemies, stops at a wall and zaps 3 times every 250 ms within 70, new targets first.

The 2026-10-25 changes are built, not yet run in the lab: scenario fix-specs-arcane (orb); the orb logs "thunder orb: speed 2.00 px/tick" when shot.
summary:
You launch a slow-moving orb of lightning that passes through enemies. Every 0.25s it zaps up to 3 enemies in range, dealing Lightning damage. It prefers enemies it hasn't zapped yet. If it hits a wall, it stops there and keeps zapping until its duration (3s base at max lvl, 2s base at lowest lvl) runs out.

How the targeting works: every tick fires its 3 zaps no matter how many enemies are in range.
- In a mob: zaps spread to new targets, so the orb sweeps damage through the pack as it travels.
- Fewer than 3 enemies: the extra zaps go to enemies already in range.
- Lone boss: all 3 zaps hit the boss every tick.
